title: Chapter 1: It Seems the Duchess is Coming to Marry 2
content: To avoid my own ruin, I wished that she would continue to sulk like this, but if she returned to the academy and her desire for revenge reignited due to some incident, I wouldn't be able to handle it.
It was best to somehow change her mind while I still had the chance; that thought crossed my mind.
“Alicia-sama, welcome to the Brave Family. You must be tired. Although it's a small room, please rest here.”
Ignoring my words, she walked into the mansion.
As I smiled and watched Alicia's back, I turned my attention to the thing I had caught when I brushed my shoulder earlier.
“Gigi, gi…”

In my palm, a small black caterpillar writhed, letting out a pained cry. This was the cause of my involuntary “Whoa!” when I first saw her; it was a small demonic creature we referred to as a Magic Bug in the Brave Family.

This Magic Bug harbored a curse, possessing people and causing mischief. It was the embodiment of symptoms known as paralysis poison, mental corruption, and incurable diseases. Those afflicted by it could not lead a decent life.
Alicia was surrounded by a staggering number of these Magic Bugs—about a hundred, to be exact.
“Haah… what a grudge I’ve inherited, huh?”

A troublesome existence born from someone’s resentment. Given the events that had transpired, it was only natural. However, one would expect that being infested with so many Magic Bugs would prevent a normal person from thinking straight, yet she remained calm and composed.
“Could it be that the Magic Bugs are keeping her quiet?”
No, I shook my head; that was impossible. A person possessed by Magic Bugs would become more pathological, obsessively believing in something.
“Ah, I might need to revise my way of thinking a bit.”

Having thought that far, I finally began to understand. How could a duchess, who had been educated to eventually become a queen through marriage to the crown prince of the kingdom, get into a duel with a commoner?
Our parents, from the generation above us who valued tradition, would never allow such a thing. It was normal for them to side with the noble lady.
Having lived as a noble for fifteen years in this world, I wasn’t foolish enough not to understand that.
“Haah, is this how it is in the world of otome games?”
I sighed, realizing how convenient it all was. To achieve a romance between a commoner and a noble, there were many walls to overcome, but first, I had to create a rival, an enemy.
The creators must have devised something to distort the differences in status to entertain us, the purchasers of the game.
Thinking about it this way made the world seem incredibly twisted. It was the worst to have my life endangered due to such convenience.
“What should I do from here…? No, what can I do? I have to welcome her as my fiancée and end up attending the academy next month…?”
The number of Magic Bugs could be seen as the malice, hostility, and harmful intent directed at me, and I was supposed to live a school life with such a woman.
Despair. It felt like I was heading to my own death.
If someone had sent these Magic Bugs and was forcing me to act according to their convenience, then if I changed her mind, my life would be in danger too.
“Too dangerous.”
If destruction awaited me no matter which way things turned, it would be better for her to at least change her heart.
After all, this was a marriage proposal, she was beautiful, and she had a nice figure.
It would be more righteous for her to shake off her feelings for her former fiancé and recover, then go on to slay the enemies that come at us.
In that case, she might be something like my target for conquest.
“Yeah, that’s right! Since we’ve formally become engaged, I have to somehow get her to look my way!”
At first, I thought it would be quickest to have her die quietly somewhere, but seeing her face, she was a strong woman capable of enduring over a hundred Magic Bugs.
Having witnessed her being tossed around by the convenience called fate, my sinister thoughts had vanished before I knew it.
“Wasn’t I told to look forward no matter the situation?”
By my late father.
I had planned to leave the kingdom eventually and live independently of the Brave Family, but it wasn’t that I disliked my family at all.
On the contrary, I loved them dearly.
Now that I had survived, it was my duty to carry on the legacy of my family, who had fallen gloriously in battle.
Having children to ensure the continuation of the Brave Family was my tribute to them, gulp.
“I’ll do my best…”
As I crushed the Magic Bug tightly in my hand, I steeled my resolve.
Huh? Why can I crush a cursed Magic Bug, you ask?
Because I’m from the Brave Family, of course. Sebas can do it too.
Five days had passed since Alicia came to our home.
During this time, I had been carefully observing her movements, but she hadn’t caused any disturbances or uttered any curses; for now, she was living quietly.

Since she had been holed up in her room, we hadn’t shared a meal together, so I had no opportunity to speak with her, and I had no idea what she was thinking. However, she didn’t seem to be contemplating anything particularly troublesome.
While I felt relieved, I was faced with a new problem.
“Ugh, this is annoying.”
While juggling my chores, I was also keeping an observation journal on Alicia and was constantly busy exterminating Magic Bugs.
The Magic Bugs that had infested her were scattered throughout the house, and finding and squashing them was driving me insane.
In addition to sticking directly to her, they could also be launched from a distance using magic that utilized her hair as a catalyst.
As a result, Magic Bugs were continuously sent flying into my home, sticking to the windows with a squelching sound and wriggling around.
“Shoo, shoo!”
“You’re working hard, young master.”
When the bugs piled up to the point of being bothersome, I would open the window to clear them out, and Sebas watched my antics with amusement.
“You can see them too, Sebas. Help me out. There are an insane number of them!”
I was reminded of the stink bugs that swarm and stick to windows and walls in the spring.
When caught, stink bugs emit an unpleasant odor, and when squashed, the Magic Bugs release a bit of their curse, which is equally unpleasant.
And all of them were mental corruption curses, which was exhausting.
Clearly, someone was targeting Alicia, attempting to exploit her desire for revenge by sending these bugs.
“Well, you’re a young master, so you should be fine with this much.”
“Of course.”
There was no way that the Brave Family’s bloodline could be cursed by just this many Magic Bugs.
We fought against monsters with much stronger mental corruption abilities, and enemy nations also use forbidden mental manipulation magic to attack us.
As a countermeasure, the Brave Family recommends awakening through pain.
If you endure pain to the point of knowing the fear of death, you become unshakable against minor mental attacks.
“But adding this extermination to my chores is a bit…”
“If you’re going to sulk and keep a journal, wouldn’t it be quicker to stay by her side and continue exterminating? If you’re always together, the Magic Bugs will eventually stop coming.”
“Ugh… but getting too close all of a sudden is a bit…”
“If you show the spirit of protecting your cursed fiancée in a romantic story, someone will take over your chores for you.”
“Even if you say that…”
The Brave Family had always been hopeless in that regard.
Because we were more accustomed to the battlefield than to women, I had no idea how to respond.
“The women who marry into the family are generally in despair, and I still don’t understand how I was born from that battle-crazed father.”
“Hmmm, if I were to give you advice… well, the late eldest son was born a year after the previous head suffered life-threatening injuries in a decisive battle with a neighboring country.”
“Is that so…?”
The sudden revelation of my father’s affair.
After nearly dying, does the survival instinct kick in to leave an heir?
“The trigger for your birth was a one-on-one battle with a demon, and he lost an eye.”
“Ah, enough already! Shut up!”
I didn’t want to hear such stories about my parents.
Would I end up becoming like that too, having inherited their blood?
A beast, a beast.
It hadn’t been a problem before since I had only dealt with lesser nobles who had been discarded, but if I did something like that to a duchess, I could easily be framed for a crime and executed.
It was terrifying, terrifying.
Even though I had caused a commotion and ended up engaged, I was still someone who could have my position as a count jeopardized if I acted rudely.
“Then, am I just going to keep slowly exterminating these Magic Bugs?”
“Ngigi…”
Sebas was a bothersome but accurate nuisance, poking at my weak points.
If they were directly attached, it would be one thing, but the fact that the Magic Bugs were flying in was also a problem related to her heart.
I had to somehow help her recover, but I had never understood the hearts of noblewomen, and I was steeped in prejudice. What could I possibly do?
I steeled my resolve.
“It’s impossible to suddenly become that close to a woman I just met five days ago! This issue is extremely delicate, so I’ll handle it slowly!”
“Good grief, what are you saying with that resolved expression…? In a month, our relationship will be common knowledge, and we’ll be attending the same academy, so I’m worried about the future.”
“Damn it! It’s all the Magic Bugs’ fault! Who keeps sending so many of them?!”
No matter how many I squashed, they kept appearing from everywhere.
I felt like I was going insane with all these unfamiliar experiences.
“Should I just follow the direction they’re being sent from and kill whoever is sending them?”
In a month, I could pinpoint their location and eliminate them.
If it wouldn’t stop until I cut the source, then I should cut the source.
“You can’t do that. The Brave Family doesn’t have a justifiable reason, so if you cause a commotion, we’ll be the ones to suffer. You have the mission of ensuring the Brave Family’s survival.”
When he said that, I had no choice but to relent. I twirled my palm.
“Sebas, lend me a hand. I’ll do my best. I’m not good at handling ladies, so I need you to support me properly as a butler.”
“That’s not a very manly resolve.”
“Shut up! If I mess up and get hated, it’s all over!”
“What exactly do you intend to have me help you with? You’re you, so just approach her as you are. If you try to put on a facade, you won’t earn her trust.”
“As I am…? But I can’t just go to the dungeon with her, right?”
“Yes, that would be dangerous.”
“Then what the hell should I doooooo?!”
Having reached a deadlock, I slammed my head against the sturdy desk, built to withstand the power of the Brave Family.
I could manage paperwork and chores to some extent because I had the memories of the foundational education I received in my previous life.
Romance? Sadly, I had no memories of that even in my past life!
And what about since I was born into this world?

“I’ve been a brat raised on combat education since I was three! I had no time to play with others! Monster subjugation and war! Even sibling interactions were just fights or training! And Alicia is the first girl my age I’ve ever met!”
Hah, hah… what even is love… what is youth…?
The only games a boy my age could play were subjugating monsters or finding and killing enemy spies.
I knew that the Brave Family was a being completely removed from the general public, even within the already isolated Brave Territory.
Even so, I was trying my best to think of something, to manage as peacefully as possible, without any bloodshed.
“Hah… but if I reach my limit, it won’t mean anything to stop, you know? I’ll make the one sending the Magic Bugs pay in blood.”
“Well, please don’t be so bloodthirsty. I have an idea.”
While calmly observing my agitated state, Sebas continued speaking.
He had been taking care of me since I was born, yet he was a truly hopeless butler who would come to tease me on purpose.
“So, what’s your idea?”
“Why not invite Alicia-sama for a tour of the town?”
“A tour of the town?”
“If it’s just a tour, even you can manage that, and it’s not too dangerous. It’s a perfect excuse to take her out since she can’t keep holed up in her room forever.”
“I see.”
“She’s been working hard every day, so it’s about time she took a break.”
Coming from someone who had been overwhelmed with unfamiliar work every day, the word “break” sounded incredibly sweet.
It was a bit disappointing that I couldn’t take her to the dungeon, but it was important to let her know about the Brave Territory first, so I would do my best to make the duchess happy.
“Sebas, by the way, is there anything worth seeing in this town? Any places for sightseeing? I don’t know if there are any, but…”
“There aren’t any.”
“Yeah, I figured.”
I had asked in hopes of getting some ideas on where to take her for a tour, but I received the expected response.
Even though it was my territory, it was truly hopeless.

“Anywhere you go, there are only places where roughnecks gather. There are frequent betting games on which soldier or adventurer will die next. By the way, some even got rich after the previous head was killed in battle.”
“That’s outrageous. Who was it? Tell me so I can kill them.”
“I’ve already dealt with them.”
“Oh, I see.”
Yeah, it was outrageous, but that was normal here.
Human lives were incredibly cheap, which is why it was called Discarded Land.
“Even if I give her a tour of the town, won’t she be put off instead…?”
“In a way, it’s a once-in-a-lifetime gamble for the Brave Family, haha.”
This isn’t something to laugh about!
“Well, at least the nature is rich, right? I’ll take her somewhere safe. Once she sees the great outdoors of the Brave Territory, all her unpleasant thoughts should blow away.”
“Do you think a young lady from the city will enjoy a place with only trees and monsters?”
“Hey, why do you always have to say things like that?”
This guy really had a bad personality.
“I’ve been instructed to raise you strictly by the previous head.”
“Damn it!”
Seeing him smile while stroking his beard, I firmly vowed in my heart to bet a large sum on his death.
The next day, having received a day off, I stood in front of Alicia’s room to invite her.
Before knocking on the door, I thought for a moment while crushing the swarm of Magic Bugs that had invaded through the gaps in the mansion and were sticking to the door.
“Hmmm… would it be weird to just show up first thing in the morning…?”
We weren’t even at the stage of sharing meals together, nor had we even exchanged punches.
Sebas’s idea was to deepen our friendship while giving her a tour of the town, but I was stalling on how to approach that first step.
“Young master, you’re in the way.”
“Huh? Is that Alicia’s breakfast?”
I was nudged aside by a maid pushing a cart with Alicia’s breakfast on it.
“Gah, gah, gah.”
“Um… could you please stop nudging me like that?”
“It’s your fault for standing there. We’re short-staffed and need to move on to the next job, so please step aside.”
What is with everyone? I’m clearly the next lord!
However, seeing the cart gave me an idea.
“I’ll deliver it for you, so you can go on to your next task.”
“Is that so? Then thank you.”
As the maid hurried off, I put my plan into action.
I knew that there were tea parties called “afternoon teas” at the academy!
So why not mimic that?
Savoring breakfast while elegantly sipping coffee and engaging in conversation… that’s right, girls love a good morning!
“Alicia-sama, good morning! Here’s your breakfast!”
I knocked on the door, but there was no response.
It would be easy to just open the door and walk in, but since she was a woman, I continued knocking.
“Knock, knock, knock! Crack, crack, crack!”
“Everyone loves a good morning! Let’s eat together!”
“I’m awake! I’m awake, so you can come in! The door is going to break!”
I was relieved to hear that she was awake.
Unlike the lower-class nobles who lacked the courage to die, I had briefly worried that an educated woman might choose to take her own life, but it seemed I didn’t need to worry.
“Excuse me!”
As I pushed the cart into the room, I found Alicia sitting in a chair, looking a bit haggard as she glared at me.
“How rude! What if the door breaks?”
“If it breaks, we’ll just fix it again. The Brave Territory gets broken all the time, you know. Thanks to that, I’ve become quite skilled at repairs.”
When I was a child, sibling fights had broken various parts of the house, and when wars started, nearby villages would often be turned to ashes, and monsters could easily cause riots.
Even so, the people living in the Brave Territory could be said to possess the resilience of weeds.
“Is that so…? A noble repairing things…”
“More importantly! Here, breakfast!”
The ham sandwich prepared by the maid was made with fresh vegetables and soft bread, looking very delicious.
Brave Family boys are generally fed monsters, which is quite enviable.
It’s normally poisonous, but if you get used to it from a young age, you can handle it surprisingly well.
“More importantly…?”
“Since it’s my first time sharing breakfast with a woman, I may be a bit rude, so I would appreciate it if you could point it out as we go.”
I moved the breakfast from the cart to the table and brewed some coffee.
“Would you like milk? How about sugar? It’s said that women in the Brave Territory prefer sweet coffee.”
She had been silent for a while, so I kept talking, and Alicia murmured.
“…I’ve never had it, so I don’t know. At home, we usually had tea.”
“Is that so?”
What a waste not to drink coffee.
In this world, it’s readily available at a low price, while tea is so expensive that we’ve always stuck to coffee.
Is it a noble thing to prefer high-quality tea over cheap coffee?
No, no, you can’t get strength from tea.
You can’t get through paperwork without downing caffeine first.
In the Brave Territory, where we sometimes fight day and night, cheap coffee is a source of strength.
“I apologize for not being able to prepare tea; after all, we’re a rural territory in the outskirts.”
“…I don’t really mind.”
Alicia replied, hiding her true feelings, and without any complaints, she took a gulp of the coffee I served.
They say when in Rome, do as the Romans do, but few can put that into practice, so for her to drink without complaint makes her quite a good woman.
“Cough, cough! It’s… bitter…”
Her face turned pale as she coughed.
“You should have started with black coffee. Let’s go with something sweet at first.”
That’s how it is when you’re not used to it, right?
I wanted to serve her something she was used to, but tea was out of the question and incredibly expensive in the outskirts, so I had no choice but to make her endure it.
“…Ah, sweet. I might be able to drink this.”
“Be careful with unsweetened coffee before bed, as it can keep you awake. Mmm, this richness.”
It seemed she liked it, so I savored my coffee as well.
I usually drink black coffee in the morning when doing paperwork, but I’m a natural sweet tooth.
Drinking a sweet beverage that’s a mix of milk and coffee is my comfort in this harsh other world.
“After eating a bit, I’ll send someone to fetch you, so let’s change and go outside. Staying holed up in your room isn’t good for your body or mind.”
When things get tough, exercising to forget is the best. It’s fine to unleash your desire for revenge on monsters. No matter how many you kill, they keep coming back, right?
“…I’ve been curious about this…”
Holding the cup with both hands, Alicia stared at my face and asked.
“Why are you doing this when you have servants?”
“Simply because we’re short-staffed. If necessary, the servants will fight too, and recently, most of them died in battle.”
“…I see.”
When I answered normally, Alicia gasped.
She must have realized why this place was called Discarded Land, but there was no need for her to worry; the Brave Family has a duty to stand on the front lines, but women don’t have to.
Of course, if they want to, they can stand.
Such women are quite favored in this land. So—
“Alicia-sama, you are a remarkable person.”
I lifted the hair that hung near her left eye to see her burn scar.
That must be a memory she doesn’t want to recall, so she looked down, rejecting it.
But I acknowledged it.
“It’s a mark of pride here, a symbol of courage for having fought with honor.”
If you die, it’s over, but she survived.
In the Brave Family, a defeat without death is not a loss; it’s the honor of stubbornly surviving and standing up again.
“Of course, I have my own scars as well.”
I lifted my bangs to show her the scar on my forehead.
The scar I received from an orc in my childhood still remained.
At that time, I learned the fear of battle, overcame it, and became who I am now.
“We don’t deny scars here. In fact, we take pride in them.”
Having said that, I realized I had gotten incredibly close to Alicia.
I had only intended to look at her burn scar, but as she tried to pull away, I had inadvertently grabbed her chin roughly, as if examining an injured soldier.
“Hahaha, well, the reason I brought breakfast is also to talk with you like this.”
I quickly released my hand and changed the subject.
“It’s a territory filled with roughnecks and nothing else, but the nature is rich, so why don’t we take a walk together? In the face of nature, human disputes are trivial here.”
“Trivial…”
That’s right; in the face of nature, we humans are insignificant beings.
Dragons, Fenrirs, giants—those are all just as insignificant.
A duel between nobles is even more trivial.
“…I’ll go.”
As I pondered these thoughts, Alicia quietly spilled her words.
“Could you please guide me through this land?”
“Of course, I’d be delighted.”
She looked straight at me, and unlike five days ago, her eyes were filled with warmth.
They were the eyes I liked.
The Brave Territory has a massive mountain range nearby, rich in valuable herbs and minerals.
In the face of such abundant nature, one might wonder why we are so poor; it’s because the mountains are teeming with monsters.
In addition to the countless monsters, neighboring countries regularly invade.
Because of this, development has stalled, and the monsters have increased to a disaster level.
It’s an incredibly dangerous place, yet there remains a lot of untouched nature.
There are plants and minerals here that you wouldn’t see or hear about in the royal capital.
I had thought that one day I would eradicate the monsters and use my modern knowledge to make a name for myself in this world, but as the third son who only knows fighting, I had given up on that.
“This is the Yudaina Mountain Range, which is beyond human control.”
As I explained this to Alicia, who had come with me into the mountains, she looked pale and exhausted.
Having walked along the beast path, it was no wonder she was tired.
I had intended to tire her out so she couldn’t think too much, but she was a duchess who had received a high-level education, so I was impressed she could keep up with me.
I had gotten a bit carried away and ventured deeper.
“What are you doing bringing me to such a dangerous place…?”
“Killing my fiancée would be a disgrace for the Brave Family.”
Alicia, who was tired but still listened to my explanation, showed a hint of fear.
Even if I pretended it was an accident, I would be held responsible for bringing her to a dangerous place.
“I thought we’d walk in the town, not in a mountain like this… I was expecting to be introduced to shops or local specialties…”
“Hahaha, there’s nothing like that here.”
When I flashed a smile I had learned from Sebas, Alicia slumped her shoulders.
So this is what it felt like when I forced a smile at her.
“Alicia-sama, didn’t you see on the way here? The town is filled with roughnecks!”
There were many adventurers, and none of them were here for sightseeing; they were here for the monsters.
The services provided for them were practical rather than glamorous.
As long as they could eat, drink, and maintain their weapons, they were satisfied.
As long as they could buy and sell what they obtained from subjugating monsters, that was enough.
They weren’t exactly the most upstanding individuals, so there was no way the tourism industry could thrive.
Wealthy nobles wouldn’t dare come, and if they did, it would undoubtedly lead to trouble.
Even so, they were convenient because they would go to fight if you threw money at them.
“If we decorate the territory poorly, it won’t be accepted by these roughnecks, and if the enemy finds it attractive, the damage will only increase.”
So if you ask why skirmishes continue, it’s because the upper echelons are instigating them.
